en:
The most important fact we discovered
during the investigation is this...

The shot put ball that Rantaro was killed with,
was <CLT=cltSTRONG>different<CLT=cltNORMAL> than the one Kaede had!

What'd you say!?
I have no idea what's going on!
A different shot put ball? What do you mean?

I found a shot put ball in the trashcan
in the hidden room.

But it was not the murder weapon. That shot
put ball didn't have any blood on it.
Rather...
...there was a <CLT=cltSTRONG>pink fiber<CLT=cltNORMAL> stuck to that shot.
...Pink fiber? So what?

Do you remember how Kaede was
carrying the shot put ball?

...Kaede's backpack.
She was carrying the shot put ball in there.

Despite its weight, it would have been
easy to carry in a backpack.

I noticed you also had a spare vest,
which you could have wrapped it in.

That would prevent the cameras you
were carrying from being damaged.
I see... She had it in her backpack!
It was wrapped in her spare vest.
Her <CLT=cltSTRONG>*pink* vest<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

I see... The shot put ball you found in the
hidden room had a pink fiber on it...
Yes, it's a fiber from her vest.

That can only mean that the ball I found
was the one that was in Kaede's backpack.

Wh-What'd you say!? Really, I got no idea
what you're talkin' about!

That shot put ball did not have blood on it,
so it could not have been the murder weapon.

In short, the shot that Kaede used
didn't hit Rantaro!

Th-Then...maybe they just washed off
the blood!

If so, the fiber on the shot put ball would
have been washed off as well!

It's clear to me that the real murder weapon
is <CLT=cltSTRONG>different<CLT=cltNORMAL> than the shot Kaede had.

Yes, Kaede set up the bookcase and
rolled the shot into the vent...

But that shot didn't hit Rantaro!
Her plan <CLT=cltSTRONG>failed<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
F-Failed!? I don't even know what that means!

I-If you found that shot put ball
in the hidden room, then that means...

<CLT=cltMIND>I found the shot put ball
in the hidden room because...
It was always there

The shot put ball was always
in the hidden room.

...Huh?
Is there something wrong about that?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
The mastermind took it
Monokuma took it
Monokuma took it away!

How many times do I gotta repeat myself?
I can't help a killing game participant.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
The Monokubs took it
The Monokubs took it away!
What!? We did!?

That's impossible! We can't help the
participants!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Well?
I wanna know the answer!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>I found the shot put ball
in the hidden room because...

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>mastermind<CLT=cltNORMAL> took it from the library.
Only they could get in that room, after all.
The mastermind took it?

So they recovered the shot that missed
Rantaro, and he was killed by a different one.

Rantaro was killed by the mastermind, who
made it look like Kaede was the culprit.

That required a bit of trickery on the
mastermind's part...

They prepared their own shot to kill Rantaro
and switched it with Kaede's shot.

They took Kaede's shot put ball and stowed it
in the hidden room.

To put it simply...Kaede didn't kill
Rantaro, it was the mastermind!
What!
Did you!
Sayyyyy!?

EVERYONE, CALM-DOWN!
FATHER-IS-GOING-TO-YELL—
What! Monodam, why!?

Whoops. I got too worked up and
accidentally pressed the detonator.
BLRGLGRBLRBLRGLRBLG...
The mastermind killed Rantaro...but why?

I believe the reason had something to do
with the <CLT=cltSTRONG>time limit<CLT=cltNORMAL> motive.

A time limit is now in effect! If a murder does
not occur by nighttime, two days from now...

then every student forced to participate
in this killing game will die!

Kaede was keeping us all together, and
we refused to kill each other.

To break up the stalemate, the mastermind
introduced that motive.

However, this was a gamble. They didn't
want to cause total chaos, after all.

Because that would just end everything.
They wanted an exciting killing game...

That motive put pressure on the mastermind
as well as us.

Yes. Kaede had a plan to kill the mastermind,
but Rantaro was caught in the trap.

However...her plan ultimately failed. The shot
put ball that she rolled didn't hit Rantaro.

Because it missed, we would've been 
annihilated due to the time limit...

But the mastermind wanted to avoid that
situation, so they took action.

Thanks to the Nanokumas, the mastermind would
have known Kaede's intended murder weapon...

So when her plan failed, they would already
have another shot put ball prepared.

Then, the mastermind manipulated the scene
to make it look like Kaede succeeded.

All they had to do was hide Kaede's shot in
the hidden room that only they could enter.
S-So...Kaede was executed on false charges!?

Yes...yes, she was.
She didn't actually kill anyone.
But she was executed nonetheless.

Because the mastermind framed
her for Rantaro's murder!

And Monokuma played along. He let us believe
the mastermind's lie.

We were all fooled, including Kaede. We thought
she was the culprit until the very end.

And you want to tell us this game is fair?
That there are rules? That's all bullshit!
This game makes no sense at all!

If Monokuma twisted the truth for this
case...

...then he could've twisted it for the other
cases as well, making this killing game unfair.

Th-Then it's not even a killing game anymore.
It's just...killing.
...I won't forgive them.

I'll never forgive them for breaking the
rules and killing Kaede.

So cruel... I'll never forgive them!
And I *will* avenge Kaede!

I swear on her kindess and her love...and
her grave that I will avenge her!

Yeah! How dare the mastermind create the
detonator that blew up the adorable Monodam!

You're the one that blew him up!
Don't pass the buck!

Anyway, we know the mastermind is also
Rantaro's killer. Let's figure out who that is.

That is, if Monokuma still wants to
continue this class trial...

Of course we're gonna keep going!
Like I said, this killing game will never end!
No, Monokuma. I will end this.

I will reveal the identity of the mastermind
and end the killing game!

U-Um... May I interject? You keep accusing
this so-called mastermind, but...

..are you sure there's even a mastermind
at all?

Are you sure you bastards aren't imagining it?
If the mastermind is real, show 'em to us.
You guys are the ones hiding them!

It's possible the mastermind is still in this
academy. The Survivor Perk said so.

If they were involved in Rantaro's
murder, there's no doubt.

Then they must have snuck in during the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Gofer Project<CLT=cltNORMAL> and stayed hidden in the aca—
Ah!

You just ah'd! 
What was that "ah" about?
I just realized something...

Say it! Or I'll cast my "All the Guys 
You Date Will Be Single Fathers" curse!
It's...<CLT=cltSTRONG>Kaede's younger twin sister<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
<CLT=cltMIND>...Her what?
Younger...twin sister?

It was on this Gofer Project participant list.
She has a <CLT=cltSTRONG>twin sister<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

It seemed sorta weird to me.
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Junko Enoshima<CLT=cltNORMAL> had a twin, too, right?

Are you saying those same circumstances
apply here, as well?

This killing game was influenced a lot
by the past one, right?

So maybe the mastermind's real identity
was, too.

<CLT=cltMIND>The mastermind who snuck into the
academy and made us play this sick game...
<CLT=cltMIND>...Is Kaede's twin sister?
M-Maybe... I guess that's a possibility...

Either way, there's no doubt that the mastermind
is hiding somewhere in this school.

How unfortunate that you couldn't find them
during your final investigation.

You're not allowed to leave while the trial's in
session, so you can't search for them now.

You can't leave during a trial unless you
gotta pee!
Oh! I gotta pee!
We're not falling for that one!

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaede's twin sister...?
Is the mastermind still hiding somewhere?

<CLT=cltMIND>Is she really the mastermind?
Is it really that simple?
